name: 359-splash
notes: #359 B3.a splash: two kids ankle-deep at the pond's real edge (the edge found from the pond's middle out to the group, as B4 finds it), 0.25 u apart along the bank. View/Beats/KidPlay2.cs SplashGame: crouch, arms down and back, the sweep through the water (Contact at arms x 60: a ring at the hands, droplets aimed at the partner; the 'spray' object rides them), the partner is soaked as they land (jolts back, arms up), laughs and splashes back. The 5th or 6th exchange: one jumps in (squash, a hop out 0.13 u, lands sunk 0.06 in a ring and ten droplets), the other squeals, it wades back; then both wade out and shake off (the end beat). HitFx: Ring + Droplets (aimed) on each splash, Ring + Droplets on the jump, 4 Droplets each on the shake. AnimLab: cheat 'Kids play: splash' (pond with water, else the nearest puddle).
